title: Listening to elders; Fletcher Henderson band and the Lanin and Lopez bands
summary: Armstrong says he preferred the elders as a teenager, lists Fletcher Henderson band members at the Roseland at 24, and tells of hearing Sam Lanin's and Vincent Lopez's bands and an older trumpeter, B. A. Rolfe, playing seriously.
